p.src: 11  In those letters, the king granted the Jews who were in every city to gather themselves together and to defend their lives—to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish all the power of the people and province that would assault them, their little ones and women, and to plunder their possessions, 12  on one day in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus, on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.
